Two item types: 379 font pairings/trios under /pairs/ -> registry:style (all 379 individually validated via https://www.fonttrio.xyz/r/{name}.json, unique verbatim descriptions), and 1926 individual Google fonts under /fonts/ -> registry:font (slugs from sitemap; type confirmed by a 15-item sample; descriptions are formulaic '{Title} - {Category} font.'; only the 15 sampled fonts carry a verbatim description, the rest have description=null to respect the per-registry request cap). Total 2305 items.

Next.js site with no sitemap and 404 on all index endpoints. Recovered from linked GitHub repo abhix4/grainly-icons registry.json. NOTE: that file has leftover template metadata (top-level name 'itshover', homepage itshover.com) but its 23 items are grainly's real icons - confirmed by live validation of https://grainlyicons.abhii.space/r/activity.json (registry:ui) and by the homepage listing the same 23 icons ('23 total icons', 'Grained on top of Lucide'). All registry:ui, no descriptions in JSON.

items.name: headcode
items.description: An agent-ready CMS for Next.js with Convex, admin editing, Markdown output, and MCP tools

notes: Live registry is auth-gated: https://headcodecms.com/r and /registry return 401 (invalid_token / 'No authorization provided'); guessed /r/{name}.json paths hit the Next.js 404 catch-all. Recovered the item list from the public GitHub source headcodecms/headcodecms registry.json, which defines a single item 'headcode' (registry:component). Docs describe reusable page blocks called 'sections' (meta, hero, text, snippet, code, header, footer) bundled inside the one headcode component rather than published as separate registry items. Install: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add headcodecms/headcodecms/headcode.
